  • Constructor Details

    • Anime

      public Anime(int release, String title, String synopsis, ArrayList<Genre> genres, String alternativeTitle, String studio, Status status)
      Constructs a new Anime media entry with its specific attributes and initializes an empty episode list.

      Precondition: genres list must not be null. release year should be a positive integer.
      Postcondition: An Anime instance is initialized, linking its base details to the underlying MediaEntry.

      Parameters:
      release - The release year of the anime series.
      title - The main title of the anime.
      synopsis - A short summary or plot description of the anime.
      genres - A list of genres associated with this anime.
      alternativeTitle - An alternate or localized title for the anime.
      studio - The animation studio that produced the series.
      status - The current tracking status.

  • Method Details

    • addEpisode

      public void addEpisode(int release, String title, String synopsis)
      Adds an individual episode details object to the anime's record history.

      Precondition: Title and synopsis should be valid string instances.
      Postcondition: A new Details instance is appended to the internal episodes array, and lastModified timestamp is updated.

      Parameters:
      release - The release year of the specific episode.
      title - The sub-title of the episode.
      synopsis - Brief thematic overview of the episode.

    • setStudio

      public void setStudio(String newStudio)
      Changes the studio responsible for the Anime. Precondition: newStudio is not null.
      Postcondition: The studio assigned to the Anime is updated.
      Parameters:
      newStudio - The new studio assigned to the Anime.
